questions.question: What is the term for the advanced technology within machine learning that uses neural networks?
What is the term for the AI technology that uses deep learning to generate new data?
For each example (a-d), indicate which is most closely related: A Machine learning, B Deep learning, C Generative AI.

items.text: Recognizing pedestrians on the road in autonomous driving.
Automatically generating new images from text.
Recommending products based on a user's purchase history.

questions.question: From the following options, choose the one that correctly describes the relationship between AI, machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI.
options: AI > Deep Learning > Machine Learning > Generative AI
Machine Learning > AI > Generative AI > Deep Learning
AI > Machine Learning > Deep Learning > Generative AI
Generative AI > Deep Learning > Machine Learning > AI

questions.question: From the following options, choose the one that is NOT an appropriate example of generative AI.
Generative AI can produce text that sounds plausible but is factually incorrect.

Generative AI can produce text that sounds plausible but is factually incorrect (a "hallucination"). Explain why it is dangerous to use such output as the answer to a school report as-is, and state what learners should do instead.
questions.model_answer: It may contain incorrect information that sounds convincing. Learners should verify important information using reliable sources before using it.

questions.question: Analyze the relationship between AI, machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI. In your answer: use the idea of nested categories, and give one example of each.
questions.model_answer: AI is the broad field; machine learning is within AI; deep learning is within machine learning; generative AI is a type of deep learning application. Example: AI - a chess-playing program; ML - a spam filter; deep learning - image recognition; generative AI - an image-generating tool.
